Abati Samuel designs products people trust and landing pages that drive results. As a UI Designer, I create intuitive web and mobile experiences, build high-performing websites, and develop design systems that keep products consistent and built for growth.

Projects and clients I've worked with: Fathom, Clouddley, Studiosphere, Satya, and more.

My Process

Four steps between a vague idea and something people actually use. Anyone can start at the screen, the harder part is knowing what the screen is supposed to solve, for whom, and why now. That question shapes everything downstream, so it’s the one I start with.

01Understand I start with the business goal, not the screen.
02Structure Flows, states, and edge cases before pixels.
03Design High-fidelity UI with a system behind it.
04Ship I build too. Landing pages, prototypes, front-end handoff.

Let’s build something people
actually want.

Whether you’re starting from scratch or refining what exists, I’m ready to help.
